newsitem.title: UK: Small strike may extend Conoco UK refinery shutdow.
newsitem.headline: Small strike may extend Conoco UK refinery shutdow.

text.p: A five week maintenance shutdown at Conoco U.K.'s Killingholme refinery may be extended by a couple of days because of earlier industrial action by contractors over smoking breaks, a company spokesman said.
"We may lose a couple of days because of industrial action but that is over now and we hope we may even be able to catch up some time," he said.

The shutdown at the 130,000 barrels per day (bpd) refinery began in the first week of May and has been scheduled to last for five or six weeks. Apart from the industrial action, the maintenance programme is running more or less according to plan, the spokesman added.
Conoco is a unit of the U.S. giant DuPont Co.
